@toolbarToggleSidebar.description: Toolbar icon button tooltip and accessible name; shows or hides the schema sidebar.

@toolbarRefresh.description: Toolbar icon button tooltip; reloads the schema and the active tab.

@toolbarNewQuery.description: Toolbar icon button tooltip; opens an empty SQL query tab.

@plateNoConnection.description: Connection plate in the toolbar when nothing is connected.

@plateVia.description: Connection plate route when the connection passes through an SSH jump host.

@plateReadOnly.description: Visible badge and accessible name on a read-only connection in the connection plate.

@plateSwitchLabel.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the connection plate switcher button.

@plateCurrent.description: Accessible label for the active connection inside the connection switcher popover.

@envTag.description: Short uppercase environment tag in the connection plate. Keep it very short; it sits beside a colored dot.

@sidebarFilter.description: Placeholder of the sidebar search field.

@sidebarFilterLabel.description: Accessible name of the sidebar search field.

@sidebarObjectsLabel.description: Accessible name of the sidebar tree of tables, views and functions.

@sidebarNoConnections.description: Sidebar empty state when no connection is saved.

@sidebarNewConnection.description: Primary button in the sidebar empty state and connection switcher.

@sidebarNoMatches.description: Sidebar empty state when the filter text matches no tables, views or functions.

@sidebarClearFilter.description: Button that clears an active search or WHERE filter.

@sidebarSection.description: Uppercase group heading in the sidebar tree.

@workspaceNoTabs.description: Workspace empty state when no tab is open and no connections exist.

@welcomeRecent.description: Section label above the quick-launch connection list on the empty workspace.

@welcomeStart.description: Section label above primary actions on the welcome view.

@tabUnsaved.description: Accessible name of the dot on a tab with staged edits.

@tabClose.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the close button on a workspace tab.

@tabNew.description: Tooltip of the plus button at the end of the tab strip.

@filterRowsLabel.description: Accessible name of the WHERE clause field above a table.

@filterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the WHERE clause filter bar above a table.

@queryRun.description: Primary button that executes the SQL in the editor.

@queryCancel.description: Button that cancels a currently running SQL query.

@queryRunning.description: Status text shown while a query is executing.

@queryExplain.description: Button that shows the query plan of the SQL in the editor.

@errorRetry.description: Action button inside an inline error banner to re-run the failed operation.

@errorDismiss.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the close button on an inline error banner.

@gridNoRows.description: Empty state shown inside a result grid when a query or table returns zero rows.

@cellEdit.description: Context menu item to edit the selected table cell inline.

@cellSetNull.description: Context menu item to stage a NULL value for the selected table cell.

@cellDeleteRow.description: Context menu item to stage the selected row for deletion.

@cellCopyValue.description: Context menu item to copy the selected cell value to the clipboard.

@ledgerPending.description: Staged-edit bar: number of row changes not yet committed.

@ledgerDiscard.description: Staged-edit bar button that drops every staged change.

@ledgerReview.description: Staged-edit bar button that opens the generated SQL for review.

@ledgerReadOnly.description: Status label replacing the Commit button in the staged-edit bar when the connection is read-only.

ledgerCommit: {env, select, prod {Commit to prod} staging {Commit to staging} other {Commit}}

@ledgerCommit.description: Staged-edit bar commit button. Protected environments name the target so the risk is explicit.

@statusRows.description: Status bar: rows loaded when all matching rows are loaded.

statusRowsOf: {shown, number} of {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

@statusRowsOf.description: Status bar: rows loaded out of all matching rows.

@elapsedSeconds.description: Query duration of one second or more.

@modalClose.description: Accessible label and tooltip of the close button in modal headers.

@modalCancel.description: Secondary button that closes a modal without applying changes.

@connModalNewTitle.description: Heading of the connection modal when creating a connection.

@connModalEditTitle.description: Heading of the connection modal when editing an existing connection.

@connTabGeneral.description: First section tab in the connection modal: engine, host, database, credentials.

@connTabSSH.description: Second section tab in the connection modal: ProxyJump and bastion credentials.

@connTabSafety.description: Third section tab in the connection modal: environment tag and read-only lock.

@connFieldEngine.description: Field label for selecting PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite.

@connFieldName.description: Field label for the human-readable connection name.

@connFieldFile.description: Field label for a SQLite file path.

@connFieldHost.description: Field label for the database server hostname or IP.

@connFieldPort.description: Field label for the database server TCP port.

@connFieldDatabase.description: Field label for the default database or schema name.

@connFieldUser.description: Field label for the database login user.

@connFieldPassword.description: Field label for the database password stored in the OS keychain.

@connPasswordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder reminding that passwords are kept in the system keychain.

@connSSHEnable.description: Toggle label enabling SSH tunneling for this connection.

@connSSHJumpPath.description: Field label for ordered pre-configured jump hosts.

@connSSHHost.description: Field label for the SSH bastion hostname.

@connSSHUser.description: Field label for the SSH login user.

@connSSHAuth.description: Field label for choosing SSH Agent, Private Key, or Password.

@connSSHAuthAgent.description: Segmented option using the local SSH agent.

@connSSHAuthKey.description: Segmented option using a private key file.

@connSSHAuthPassword.description: Segmented option using an SSH password.

@connSSHKeyPath.description: Field label for the path to an SSH private key file.

@connSSHPassphrase.description: Field label for an optional SSH private key passphrase.

@connFieldEnv.description: Field label for tagging the connection as dev, staging, or prod.

@connReadOnlyLabel.description: Toggle label enforcing runtime read-only protection on the connection.

connReadOnlyHint: Blocks writes and DDL in the runtime and locks staged commits.

@connReadOnlyHint.description: Short description below the read-only toggle.

@connTest.description: Footer outline button that verifies connectivity without saving.

@connTestOK.description: Success message shown in the connection modal after a connectivity test succeeds.

@connSave.description: Primary footer button that saves the connection profile.

@connValidationRequired.description: Inline validation message when a required connection field is blank.

@reviewTitle.description: Heading of the staged-edit SQL diff review modal.

reviewSummary: {count, plural, one {# statement in 1 transaction} other {# statements in 1 transaction}}

@reviewSummary.description: Summary line above the SQL preview in the Review SQL modal.

@reviewCopy.description: Button in the Review SQL modal that copies the generated SQL to the clipboard.

@reviewCopied.description: Temporary confirmation text after copying SQL.

reviewProdNotice: Changes will execute immediately inside a transaction on {name}.

@reviewProdNotice.description: Inline safety notice shown when committing staged edits to a staging or prod connection.

@hostKeyTitle.description: Modal title when connecting to an SSH host whose key is not yet in known_hosts.

@hostKeyMismatchTitle.description: Warning modal title when an SSH host presents a different key than known_hosts.

hostKeyUnknownHint: Confirm this fingerprint before connecting for the first time.

@hostKeyUnknownHint.description: Short prompt asking the user to verify an unknown SSH host key fingerprint.

hostKeyMismatchHint: The presented key differs from known_hosts. Only continue if you expect this server's key to have changed.

@hostKeyMismatchHint.description: Warning copy shown when an SSH host key mismatch is detected.

@hostKeyFieldHost.description: Field label showing the SSH host and port being verified.

@hostKeyFieldType.description: Field label showing the SSH public key algorithm.

@hostKeyFieldFingerprint.description: Field label showing the SHA-256 fingerprint of the presented SSH host key.

@hostKeyFieldPrevious.description: Field label showing the previously trusted SHA-256 fingerprint on a key mismatch.

@hostKeyTrustOnce.description: Secondary button that trusts the SSH host key for the current session only.

@hostKeyTrustSave.description: Primary button that trusts the SSH host key and saves it to KyanDB known_hosts.
